environment: Android Studio Gradle debug build on Android 15 / API 35 AOSP x86_64 emulator
uiDriver: Playwright Android connected to installed app WebView; screenshots from emulator display

results.name: Installed Android app loads local assets, role feedback and native SQLite bridge
Buyer creates a 2 kg cash-on-delivery order totaling LKR 990
Native support request create/read/update/delete persists each change
Farmer publishes, edits, pauses and deletes an Android listing
Farmer marks the buyer order ready for pickup
Rider accepts, picks up and delivers the same order with cash collection
Buyer reads delivery result and saves an Android review
SQLite order and review survive a complete app process restart
